components: The gateway parses SQL and builds a distributed plan.
Keys and ranges map plan fragments to storage nodes.
Nodes scan, filter, and partially aggregate local data.
Cross-range writes agree on one commit timestamp and outcome.
The gateway merges ordered or aggregated shard results.
